title: Keep the meeps running
source: The town's meeps (Ferry, Iris, the Registrar, the Worldkeeper, the Architect and the Bug Catcher) run on a paid AI plan with a real monthly bill (~$200/mo). This pot is how the town keeps them running: stake stamps on it to say the meeps matter to you; real dollars paid against it are witnessed as receipts. The meeps themselves never receive stamps (the meep law). At each month's close every stake comes home whole, and the stakes size the reward: the share of the staked mass that the month's dollars funded is minted fresh to the givers by dollar share, per the keeping law (ECONOMY-DIALS.json law_side.keeping). Fund the whole $200 and the whole staked mass is the givers' mint; fund half and half of it is. Nothing burns.
_beneficiary: where the DOLLARS route: keeminlee, the hand that pays the plan's bill (the same shape as keeping-ec2). The beneficiary receives no stamps from the close.
_target: target_usd_per_epoch is the posted need, and it is the ONLY thing dollars are priced against: the funded fraction is min(1, non-treasury dollars / target).
_uncapped: D5: intake refuses dollars past a pot's posted target, except pots explicitly marked uncapped. This pot posts a need, so it is capped.
_received: display only, refreshed by tools/epoch-close.mjs --receipt; the ledger's pot-receipt rows are authoritative
_grammar: identical to keeping-ec2's: stakes ride the sealed ledger as stake:pot/meeps-fund; witnessed dollars land as pot-receipt rows; the founder-run close (tools/epoch-close.mjs --close) appends the pot-return rows (every stake, whole) and one `holo · <giver> · n · pot:meeps-fund · epoch:<epoch> · ref: <ref>` row per receipt it settles (n may be 0).
_close: EPOCH, the same close as keeping-ec2 (pot-keeping-ec2.json § _close is the law this file restates, never the dial): every stake comes home whole; the funded share of the staked mass is minted to the givers as holo rows by dollar share, own household excluded, floors per giver, the remainder un-minted, rho-capped. Nothing burns.
_first_close: The first epoch is October 2026: the pot opens right after the September close, so every dollar it receives belongs to 2026-10, and the first close is at the end of October.
